## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .` and `pytest` pass locally
- [ ] New behavior has tests (coverage stays at or above 95%)
- [ ] Wire-behavior changes note the A2A semantics they follow (and TCK/interop impact)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal paths added
- [ ] Docs and `docs/roadmap.md` updated where the change affects them
- [ ] Authored or assisted by an AI agent? It is disclosed here: <!-- tool/model, or "no" -->

AI-assisted PRs need a human approval like any other. Agents do not approve or merge.
